scaling_size_rule: Scan frozen candidate levels ascending using external comparators only. A level passes only after every declared backend/thread/trial completes cold factor+normal RHS8 below 0.5 seconds process wall. Stop at first refused/failed/missing/timeout/slow attempt in a family; retain it and mark all higher levels unmeasured. Select the largest completely passing level in the scanned prefix; native timings never select size.

memory.owned: library host_current_bytes/host_peak_bytes when reported; negative means unavailable
memory.pardiso: iparm memory is vendor-reported; owned payload and actual active factor teams unavailable

native.claims: No tiny-case throughput, scaling or Pareto claim
